memories.content: The board met twice last week without issuing a statement on the port automation memorandum. They are aware of the international union's endorsement of a similar deal at another port last month. They have not yet decided whether to endorse the memorandum.

The local's executive board has not yet issued a press release regarding endorsement of the port automation memorandum. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. A rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The local can issue a press release at any time before Monday.
